mapper.select: INSERT INTO run (seed, param_words_min, param_words_max, param_tags, param_pace, param_form, param_outcome, param_intent, param_style, tags_norm, domain_id, domain_snapshot, b0, p_min, p_max, k_outline, m_beat, tolerance_trace, picked_outline_ids, picked_beat_ids, picked_world_id, welded, novel_id, status, qc_round, step_status, anti_repro, intake_review, len_check, genre, story_kernel_version, genre_contract_version) VALUES (#{p.seed}, #{p.paramWordsMin}, #{p.paramWordsMax}, #{p.paramTags}::jsonb, #{p.paramPace}, #{p.paramForm}, #{p.paramOutcome}, #{p.paramIntent}, #{p.paramStyle}, #{p.tagsNorm}::jsonb, #{p.domainId}, #{p.domainSnapshot}::jsonb, #{p.b0}, #{p.pMin}, #{p.pMax}, #{p.kOutline}, #{p.mBeat}, #{p.toleranceTrace}::jsonb, #{p.pickedOutlineIds}::jsonb, #{p.pickedBeatIds}::jsonb, #{p.pickedWorldId}, #{p.welded}::jsonb, #{p.novelId}, #{p.status}, #{p.qcRound}, #{p.stepStatus}::jsonb, COALESCE(#{p.antiRepro}, FALSE), #{p.intakeReview}::jsonb, COALESCE(#{p.lenCheck}, FALSE), COALESCE(#{p.genre}, 'MYSTERY'), COALESCE(#{p.storyKernelVersion}, 1), COALESCE(#{p.genreContractVersion}, 1)) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE run SET welded = #{welded,jdbcType=VARCHAR}::jsonb, status = 'PLANNING', step_status = CASE WHEN #{welded,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL THEN '{"v":1,"steps":{"SAMPLE":{"status":"DONE"},"WELD":{"status":"SKIPPED"}}}'::jsonb ELSE '{"v":1,"steps":{"SAMPLE":{"status":"DONE"},"WELD":{"status":"DONE"}}}'::jsonb END, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE run SET novel_id = #{novelId}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE run SET status = #{status}, qc_round = COALESCE(#{qcRound}, qc_round), updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE run SET step_status = #{stepStatus}::jsonb, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE run SET novel_id = NULL, status = 'PLANNING', qc_round = 0, step_status = #{stepStatus}::jsonb, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
